key_insight: EHR-Complex is a large, interactive benchmark that tests whether medical AI agents can do realistic EHR reasoning across multi-table, longitudinal clinical data rather than just generate static SQL.
clinical_relevance: It reflects harder real-world hospital analytics tasks, helping identify whether clinical agents can reliably support patient-level and population-level database questions.
method: Built on MIMIC-IV with 365K patients, 31 tables, and 500M+ records
Includes about 52K tasks across six clinical intents
Requires agents to interact via SQL queries or Python code in a sandboxed environment
evidence_signal: The benchmark reports 52K tasks and average SQL complexity of 31.93 structural components per query, with the best model reaching only 62.3% exact-match accuracy and pass@k dropping below 50% at k=4 for nearly all models.
watch_item: Results are benchmark-specific and sandboxed, so performance may not directly translate to real clinical workflows or broader EHR systems.
paper_title: EHR-Complex: Benchmarking Medical Agents for Complex Clinical Reasoning
